tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: Search active job listings with optional filters
tools.sql: SELECT j.id, j.title, j.location, j.location_type, j.salary_min, j.salary_max, j.salary_currency, j.employment_type, j.category, j.experience_level, j.posted_at, j.status, c.name AS company_name, c.slug AS company_slug FROM jobs j JOIN companies c ON c.id = j.company_id WHERE j.status = 'active' AND (:category IS NULL OR j.category = :category) AND (:location_type IS NULL OR j.location_type = :location_type) AND (:experience_level IS NULL OR j.experience_level = :experience_level) ORDER BY j.posted_at DESC LIMIT :limit

category.description: Filter by category (e.g. engineering, design, marketing)

location_type.description: Filter by location type: remote, onsite, hybrid

experience_level.description: Filter by level: junior, mid, senior, lead

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get full details of a specific job listing
tools.sql: SELECT j.*, c.name AS company_name, c.slug AS company_slug, c.logo_url AS company_logo, c.website AS company_website, c.location AS company_location, c.industry AS company_industry FROM jobs j JOIN companies c ON c.id = j.company_id WHERE j.id = :job_id

tools.name: list_companies
tools.description: List companies that have posted jobs
tools.sql: SELECT c.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jobs j WHERE j.company_id = c.id AND j.status = 'active') AS active_jobs FROM companies c ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT :limit

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Get company profile with open positions count
tools.sql: SELECT c.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jobs j WHERE j.company_id = c.id AND j.status = 'active') AS active_jobs FROM companies c WHERE c.slug = :slug

tools.name: company_jobs
tools.description: List active jobs at a specific company
tools.sql: SELECT j.id, j.title, j.location, j.location_type, j.salary_min, j.salary_max, j.salary_currency, j.employment_type, j.category, j.experience_level, j.posted_at FROM jobs j JOIN companies c ON c.id = j.company_id WHERE c.slug = :slug AND j.status = 'active' ORDER BY j.posted_at DESC

tools.name: save_job
tools.description: Save a job to your saved list
tools.sql: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO saved_jobs (id, user_id, job_id, saved_at) VALUES (:__uuid, :__user_id, :job_id, :__now)

tools.name: my_saved_jobs
tools.sql: SELECT j.id, j.title, j.location, j.location_type, j.category, j.posted_at, j.status, c.name AS company_name, s.saved_at FROM saved_jobs s JOIN jobs j ON j.id = s.job_id JOIN companies c ON c.id = j.company_id WHERE s.user_id = :__user_id ORDER BY s.saved_at DESC

tools.name: my_applications
tools.description: List your job applications with status
tools.sql: SELECT a.id, a.status, a.note, a.applied_at, j.title, j.location, j.category, c.name AS company_name FROM applications a JOIN jobs j ON j.id = a.job_id JOIN companies c ON c.id = j.company_id WHERE a.user_id = :__user_id ORDER BY a.applied_at DESC
